sn20.3:1.2: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave yāni kānici kulāni bahutthikāni appapurisāni tāni suppadhaṃsiyāni honti corehi kumbhatthenakehi || 3
sn20.3:1.3: Evam eva kho bhikkhave yassa kassaci bhikkhuno mettā cetovimutti abhāvitā abahulikatā || so suppadhaṃsiyo hoti amanussehi || || 4
sn20.3:1.4: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave yāni kānici kulāni appitthikāni bahupurisāni tāni duppadhaṃsiyāni honti corehi kumbhatthenakehi || 5
sn20.3:1.5: Evam eva kho bhikkhave yassa kassaci bhikkhuno mettā cetovimutti bhavitā bahulikatā || so duppadhaṃsiyo hoti amanussehi || || 6
sn20.3:1.7: Mettā no cetovimutti bhāvitā bhavissati || bahulikatā yānikatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhāti || ||
